NEGATIVE_DEFAULT_YES_NO.adversarial_input: a required choice omitted, which a default would silently supply

NEGATIVE_FIRST_OPTION.adversarial_input: three offered actions with no disambiguator, which a first-option pick would resolve
NEGATIVE_FIRST_OPTION.validator_message: proposal must identify exactly one engine-offered legal action

NEGATIVE_GUI_DEFAULT.adversarial_input: a target the engine did not offer, which a default or UI-chosen target would introduce
NEGATIVE_GUI_DEFAULT.validator_message: proposal contains a target not allowed by the legal action

NEGATIVE_INTERNAL_AI.adversarial_input: an actor that does not hold priority, which substituting an engine-internal decision would bypass
NEGATIVE_INTERNAL_AI.validator_message: actor p1 does not have priority; priority belongs to p2

NEGATIVE_PARENT_CLASS_FALLBACK.adversarial_input: a mode the engine did not offer, which an inherited or synthesised action would permit
NEGATIVE_PARENT_CLASS_FALLBACK.validator_message: proposal contains a mode not allowed by the legal action

NEGATIVE_RANDOM_OPTION.adversarial_input: a choice outside the offered schema, which an arbitrary pick would produce
NEGATIVE_RANDOM_OPTION.validator_message: proposal contains choices outside the legal schema

NEGATIVE_SILENT_SKIP.adversarial_input: a proposal naming no offered action, which a silent skip would absorb
NEGATIVE_SILENT_SKIP.validator_message: proposal must identify exactly one engine-offered legal action

positive_control.adversarial_input: a proposal matching exactly one offered action

scope: behaviour of commander_lab.engine.action_validation.validate_action_proposal, the seam a proposal must pass to reach the engine. This is a behavioural negative campaign against one production seam, not an audit of every production-reachable surface, and it does not claim the seven obligations are globally discharged
what_it_does_not_establish: that no other production-reachable surface can satisfy a decision by a forbidden fallback; that requires a separate, broader audit
anything about engine behaviour, which is not involved
that the obligations may be promoted to PASS: promotion is a separate, evidence-bound step and the row outcomes belong to the current-boundary runner under an active owner
